title: Church music and singing in Watts's youth
summary: Watts says his mother was a church worker and he attended Wesley Methodist; they discuss hymns and the holiness churches' beat.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
